==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Huanzhen:''' Stop right there. I can sense the pulsating restless energy emanating from you.
:'''Huanzhen:''' That is something more dazzling than the morning sun, more profound than the sea- You must my alley in justice!
:{{DIcon}} How did you sense it?
:'''Huanzhen:''' Of course... I heard it from [[Chixia]]. She said she recently became friends with someone with a stern cold face and dresses all in black.
:{{DIcon}} That Ma Xiaofang!
:'''Huanzhen:''' Haha, actually it's Xiaofang... Ahem, Chixia is my senior from the previous year.
:'''Huanzhen:''' At that time, I was quite a lone kid. She would often come to the backyard of my home to play games with me.
:'''Huanzhen:''' Later, under her influence, I gradually opened up and we began to talk about fantasies of us saving the world.
:'''Huanzhen:''' However, after becoming a Patroller, I realized that everything was not quite as I imagined. Not all Patrollers has the cool and commanding air.
:'''Huanzhen:''' Personal disputes, [[Exiles]]'s scams, petty thefts... every day is just the same... These are the norm of the work.
:'''Huanzhen:''' Sometimes, you forget the birthdays of the important ones in your life while you still remember container sorting numbers at the logistics center.
:'''Huanzhen:''' I'd get tired of these trivial matters, but...
:'''Huanzhen:''' On weekends, when I take off the Patroller's uniform and see the ordinary people passing by while wandering around.
:'''Huanzhen:''' I see busy couriers rushing on the road, [[Pioneer Association]] members going on expeditions, and workers returning to [[Jinzhou]] to visit their families...
:'''Huanzhen:''' At moments like this, I'd see how our efforts have maintained the peace and order of this city.
:'''Huanzhen:''' It makes me feel cool.
{{Dialogue End}}
